descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for a hands-on Robotics & AI Engineer to join an innovative engineering team developing advanced robotic systems for the defence and military technology sector.
 This role is ideal for someone passionate about robotics, artificial intelligence, computer vision and autonomous systems, who enjoys working at the intersection of software and hardware.
 You will work with high-performance sensors and computing platforms, including LiDAR, RGB and thermal/infrared cameras, and NVIDIA embedded computing platforms. Your work will involve developing perception capabilities, training AI models, building datasets and integrating software with real-world robotic hardware.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop and implement AI and computer vision solutions for robotic and autonomous systems.
 Work with LiDAR sensors for environmental perception, object detection, spatial understanding and 3D data processing.
 Develop computer vision applications using RGB and infrared (IR)/thermal camera data.
 Train, evaluate and optimize deep learning models for object detection, classification, segmentation and scene understanding.
 Build, curate and annotate datasets for training and validation of AI models.
 Work with NVIDIA platforms, particularly NVIDIA Jetson, for deploying AI and computer vision applications on embedded hardware.
 Integrate different sensors and perception systems into robotic platforms.
 Contribute to low-level hardware integration and control, including motors, servos, BLDC motors and related actuators.
 Collaborate across software, AI and hardware engineering to develop and test robotic prototypes.
 Experiment with new technologies, troubleshoot technical challenges and take ownership of end-to-end development tasks.
 Qualifications 
 Experience with Python and AI/ML development.
 Practical experience with computer vision and deep learning.
 Experience with RGB camera data and image processing.
 Familiarity with neural network training, model evaluation and dataset preparation.
 Experience with NVIDIA platforms, ideally NVIDIA Jetson.
 Good understanding of robotics concepts, sensors and autonomous systems.
 Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on engineering mindset.
 Nice to have 
 Experience working with LiDAR sensors and point cloud processing.
 Exposure to thermal imaging and infrared camera systems.
 Experience with OpenCV, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
 Knowledge of NVIDIA CUDA and TensorRT.
 Basic knowledge of embedded systems and hardware communication protocols.
 Experience controlling or integrating motors, servos, BLDC motors or other actuators.
 Familiarity with sensor fusion, SLAM, object tracking or real-time perception systems.
 Experience with C/C++ alongside Python.
